title: Official Metadata Addon Provider Fact Resolver
problem: nako-metadata-scraper ranks isolated provider candidates and only exact-dedupes provider/provider_id pairs, so shared external IDs cannot merge provider facts before final ranking.

evidence.summary: Provider fact resolver implementation lane opened with license guardrails.
Internal resolver model added for provider facts, exact provider identity clustering, shared external ID clustering, and redaction-safe cluster evidence.
Metadata orchestration now resolves provider candidates into clusters before final ranking while preserving response compatibility.

continue_policy.notes: Implement external ID capability catalog while preserving current alias parsing and numeric validation behaviour.
